description.content: Create, retrieve, update, and manage purchase orders across the SAP Ariba Network. Supports standard and service purchase orders including new, change, cancel, and close operations.

Retrieves a paginated list of purchase order headers matching the specified filter criteria. Supports filtering by buyer, supplier, date range, status, and other order attributes. Results are returned with pagination support using skip and limit parameters.

query.description: (Required) The SAP Ariba realm identifier for the buyer organization. This is the unique site name assigned during provisioning.
Number of records to skip for pagination (default 0)
Maximum number of records to return per page (default 10, max 100)
OData-style filter expression to narrow results. Supports operators eq, ne, gt, lt, ge, le with the case-sensitive 'and' operator. Example: orderDate ge '2025-01-01' and status eq 'Ordered'
Field name to sort results by, with optional asc or desc direction
Filter by supplier AN-ID on the SAP Ariba Network
Filter by buyer AN-ID on the SAP Ariba Network
Filter orders created on or after this date (ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DD)
Filter orders created on or before this date (ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DD)

info.name: SAP Ariba Procurement Invoices Purchase Orders API

description.content:
Enables integration with SAP Ariba procurement processes including purchase orders, invoices, requisitions, receipts, and supplier management across the SAP Business Network. This API supports the complete procure-to-pay lifecycle from requisition creation through invoice reconciliation and payment processing.

 Name: SAP Ariba API Support
 Email: support@ariba.com
